text:
Noah (Finance): FYI INV-2026-0307 for Helix Labs ($48,300) hit past-due this morning. ACH bounced with reason 'account_frozen'.
Helix Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0307 marked Past Due (due 2026-04-05). Final notice queued.
Rina (AM): I spoke with Darius. They're in the middle of a merger and AP put payments on hold until escrow sign-off. asked if we can accept a wire to our escrow account or set a short payment hold.
Darius (Helix Finance): confirmed. merger counsel requested that operational spend be routed to escrow for 30 days. we can wire 40% today to a Redwood escrow account, remainder on settlement. can you provide escrow wiring instructions and a brief confirmation email to release dunning?
Omar (Collections Lead): we can suspend dunning if 40% posts and we have an explicit written plan. require: (1) wire confirmation (bank trace) and (2) email reply from Helix finance accepting schedule. waive ONE late fee as courtesy.
Tess (Legal): escrow routing is fine. recommend adding this line in the email: "This payment plan applies only to INV-2026-0307 and does not amend other contractual obligations." will paste verbatim.
Ivy (Support): heads-up they also opened a usage dispute for a high-rate surcharge on event enrichment (line 2). engineering says surcharge applied due to >100k enrichments in a burst; customer claims they configured lower throughput. might negotiate a partial credit.
Noah (Finance): include a provisional credit of $120 for the surcharge dispute to avoid friction; net outstanding becomes $48,180, 40% = $19,272. Will that work?
Darius (Helix Finance): yes, Helix accepts the $120 credit and will wire $19,272 today. please send escrow instructions and the one-line acceptance we need to reply with.
Rina (AM): drafting email now. Proposed snippet: ```Hi Darius/AP team - thanks. We confirm we will suspend dunning upon receipt of a wire for $19,272 (40% of adjusted balance) to our escrow account and receipt of your reply: "We accept the payment schedule and will pay the remaining balance in full within 30 days of merger close." Please include bank trace when wired. We will waive one late fee on receipt. Regards, Rina```
Darius (Helix Finance): replying: "We accept the payment schedule and will pay the remaining balance in full within 30 days of merger close." Wire initiated, TXN ID 0x9f3b. Bank trace will be forwarded when available.
Helix Billing Bot: Wire notice received (pending reconciliation). Please allow 1-2 business days for posting.
Omar (Collections Lead): hold escalation. If wire doesn't settle by 1782180000 (end of next week) we resume dunning. Once posted, mark invoice as PAYMENT_PLAN_ACTIVE and apply WAIVED_ONE_LATE_FEE tag.
Tess (Legal): uploaded the exact wording; use it in outgoing email so it's consistent.
Ivy (Support): I've attached the enrichment telemetry and provisional credit calc.
Noah (Finance): noted. I'll update invoicing dashboard and calendar follow-up. closing for now pending settlement. :white_check_mark:
